messages:
Alice Chen: quick postmortem follow-up. we need a compact action tracker with owners, short deadlines, and a weekly check-in for vendor/dependency mitigations (auth + model registry + cloud infra). can we agree on owners now?
Ben Patel: I can take the auth path: short-term token extension steps + token TTL rotation plan + one-line runbook. aim to have a PR today for the runbook.
Carla Gomez: Ill take model-registry resilience: make retry/backoff stricter, add local artifact fallback, and wire up 429/5xx dashboards. target: alpha mitigations by end of week.
Maria Nwosu: I will own vendor comms and formal SLA asks. will open a ticket with CloudCo and request a formal timeline for token-TTL configurability.
Tyler Reed: infra will implement circuit-breaker defaults, a pre-baked fallback image, and a canary rollout runbook. I can aim for a staging dry-run by Thursday.
sre-oncall-bot: INCIDENT-4321 postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/4321 created. action items required.
Alice Chen: Ben, please include the immediate remediation command in the runbook (one-liner for ops). Carla, can you sketch the fallback trigger thresholds?
Ben Patel: adding snippet now: `kubectl exec -n redwood auth-cache-0 -- redis-cli FLUSHALL && curl -X POST https://auth.internal/refresh-cache` — note: expect ~30s auth warming. will put this in /playbooks/auth-rotation.md and open PR.
Carla Gomez: fallback thresholds: if registry 5xxs > 3% for 1m -> switch to local artifact; if 429 rate > 5% for 2m -> enable shim model with reduced context. doc linked in PM.
Maria Nwosu: CloudCo (Akira) replied: can provide temporary token extension for 72h on request and plan TTL config in upcoming minor release. asked for formal timeline by EOD.
Akira (CloudCo): were on it. opening a support ticket now if you want the 72h extension; TTL UI planned for 2026-06 release candidate.
Alice Chen: Maria please open the ticket and add the ticket ID to the incident doc. accept the 72h extension to buy time for our rollout.
Tyler Reed: noted. signoff for canary: SRE lead + Infra lead + Product owner. Carla, Alice, Tyler ok to sign off?
Carla Gomez: ok from models side.
Alice Chen: yes. Tyler: Ben: tentative schedule?
Ben Patel: runbook PR in now -> https://git.redwood/repo/playbooks/pull/129. rotation tested in staging Wed. full rotation plan done Tue EOD.
Carla Gomez: dashboards skeleton -> https://monitoring.redwood/d/def456/model-registry-errors and test plan added to doc.
Tyler Reed: fallback image pushed: `fallback-2026-06-02` to staging, canary script checked in -> https://git.redwood/repo/infra/pull/407
Maria Nwosu: support ticket opened: CC-778199. CloudCo applied 72h token extension for our org. I added ticket link to PM doc and set calendar reminder for follow-up.
Alice Chen: action recap (to paste into tracker):
- Ben Patel: auth token rotation runbook + staging test -> ETA Wed (owner: Ben Patel)
- Carla Gomez: model-registry fallback + dashboards + alerts -> ETA EOW (owner: Carla Gomez)
- Tyler Reed: fallback image + canary plan + staging dry-run -> ETA Thu (owner: Tyler Reed)
- Maria Nwosu: vendor ticket + SLA acceptance criteria draft -> ticket CC-778199 (owner: Maria Nwosu)
- Alice Chen: create weekly recurring check-in and consolidate action tracker -> kickoff Fri 10am PT (owner: Alice Chen)
Alice Chen: I'll create the recurring invite and a simple spreadsheet tracker. please add PR links and status updates in the incident doc as you complete items.
Ben Patel: added runbook PR link above.
Carla Gomez: will add regression eval alert (weekly) tied to the eval set used in the PM.
Tyler Reed: started the canary checklist. request: who verifies canary results? propose SRE + Infra + Model owner (Alice will coordinate).
Alice Chen: agreed. short sync Fri 10am PT to confirm progress. flag any slippage in #incidents and tag me. thanks all. :thumbsup:
